description: Na₄B₄Sb₂SO₁₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.58 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. Sb is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one Sb atom.
